description: Sample player that starts the sample again on a new polyphonic channel at each trigger, so repeats overlap

params.text: Sets how many channels are cycled through, 1 to 16
Starts the sample on the next channel

inputs.text: A rising edge starts the sample on the next channel

outputs.text: The left channel of the sample, or a mix of all its channels while the right output is unpatched
The right channel of the sample, or a copy of the left one for a mono sample
How far that channel has played through the sample, over the range picked on the menu

notes: the module makes no sound until a sample is loaded from its right-click menu; until then the trigger button and the trigger input do nothing.
the loaded file is named in the patch, and opening the patch loads it again from the same path; changing the engine sample rate resamples it.
menu: load sample — opens a file dialog to choose the audio file the module plays
gain — a slider multiplying the played sample by 1 to 2
phase range — sets the voltage span of the phase output: twelve presets from +/-10V to 0V-1V, or custom for a minimum and maximum of your own
the loaded file's name — an item printed below load sample once a file is loaded; clicking it unloads the sample
